profile.headline: Lead Staff Engineer (Infrastructure) at Latitude AI
profile.summary:
I am a very outgoing introvert. I enjoy all types or engineering. I specialize in Networks and Systems as well as DevOps. My objective is to bridge the gap between software and network hardware engineering. Building tools to automate the processes and having the foresight as to which processes can be made more efficient is my passion. 

My wife and I build stuff together. I do the backend, she does the front.
